title: Navy-CIA tug-of-war over the NURO

tellings.quote: up until 1972 there was a huge tugof-war between the Navy and CIA specifically the DS&T over u who controls the neuro

plain: Until 1972, the US Navy and the CIA, America's foreign intelligence agency, are said to have fought over who would control the NURO, a secret office whose control was in dispute. On the CIA side the fight was led by its science and technology branch. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells this without naming a source and mentions Bobby Ray Inman, a senior US intelligence official, as he sketches who held power over secret programs in those years.
